title: Injective support and restriction rows on pro-etale sheaves and global sections
statement:
Fix a finite commutative ring $A$, a closed immersion $i:Z\hookrightarrow X$ of schemes, and its quasi-compact complementary open immersion $j:U\hookrightarrow X$ [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-closed-immersion, def-weil-open-immersion, def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Work with ordinary constant-$A$ module sheaves on the small pro-etale sites, in their bounded-below derived categories [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules, def-weil-pbc-bounded-derived-subcategories, def-weil-abstract-derived-category], with operations [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]. Put $i^!_0M=i^*\ker(M\to j_*j^*M)$ [def-pur-flasque-support]. Let $I$ be a bounded-below complex of injective module sheaves [def-sp-injective-resolutions] representing $K$, and set $\mathcal E=i_*i^!_0I$, $\mathcal B=I$, $\mathcal C=j_*j^*I$. Then $0\to\mathcal E\xrightarrow{u}\mathcal B\xrightarrow{v}\mathcal C\to0$ is degreewise short exact: $u$ is the canonical supported-kernel inclusion and $v$ the open adjunction unit. Each of $\mathcal E,\mathcal B,\mathcal C$, and $j^*I$ is bounded below and termwise injective on its respective site. They represent $i_*Ri^!_0K$, $K$, $Rj_*j^*K$, and $j^*K$, respectively. Writing $\Gamma_Z(X,I)=\ker(I(X)\to(j^*I)(U))$ degreewise [def-pur-support-cohomology], the sectionwise kernel and direct-image formulas identify the section row with the degreewise short exact row
$$0\to\Gamma_Z(X,I)\xrightarrow{u_X}I(X)\xrightarrow{v_X}(j^*I)(U)\to0.$$
In particular $v_X$ is restriction and is surjective in every degree as a map of $A$-modules. These complexes compute $R\Gamma(X,i_*Ri^!_0K)=R\Gamma_Z(X,K)$, $R\Gamma(X,K)$ and $R\Gamma(U,j^*K)$, with the usual right-derived-unit identifications. All the identifications and row maps are natural in chain maps of $I$.

proof.text: Use the published ordinary-coefficient pro-etale adjunctions. Evaluation preserves the kernel of the open unit; PreservesKernel.iso gives finiteKernelIso from the functor-category finiteSupportedSections to the objectwise sectionsWithSupport. Whisker with closed inverse image and transport lowerStarClosedUpperShriekAdjunction along this isomorphism. Applying Adjunction.preservesInjectiveObjects_of_preservesFiniteLimits gives injectivity preservation for finiteClosedUpperShriek; the same theorem applied to upperStarLowerStarAdjunction and openImmersionLowerShriekUpperStarAdjunction gives it for both direct images and open inverse image. The exactness instances are the published ordinary-coefficient ones.

proof.text: Apply shortExact_sectionsWithSupport to I. Cancel the invertible finiteSupportedClosedComparison in each degree to identify its existential first arrow with supportModelSequence.f; its second-arrow equation identifies g. Thus the specified sheaf row is short exact. HomologicalComplex.shortExact_iff_degreewise_shortExact gives every evaluated row. Additive functors preserve the strict lower bound, and step 1 gives each termwise injectivity assertion.

proof.text: Construct openSectionIso from global sections at the terminal object, upperStarIsoOpenImmersionRestriction, and the canonical isomorphism between the identity object over U composed with j and the object j over X. Expand globalSectionsLowerStarIso; naturality of the global-section comparison and Adjunction.unit_leftAdjointUniq_hom_app identify its composite with the open unit as restriction. The final equality is equality of two maps to the terminal object. For an injective term the published isSplitEpi_upperStarLowerStarAdjunction_unit_app_of_injective makes the unit split epic. Global sections preserve split epimorphisms. The comparison isomorphisms therefore make the literal restriction surjective. The kernel inclusion is injective and functionally exact by ShortComplex.kernelSequence and the ModuleCat exactness criterion.

proof.text: Construct supportSectionComponent by mapping the inverse finiteSupportedClosedComparison through global sections, then applying kernel-preservation isomorphisms first for evaluation and then for global sections. Transport the resulting kernel through the square of step 3 by kernel.mapIso. The kernelComparison_comp_ι equations prove its specified inclusion normalization. Cancellation of the kernel inclusion, naturality of supportModelInclusion and the global-section comparison prove naturality, giving supportSectionIso.

proof.text: Use the published Grothendieck instances for ordinary ModuleCat-valued pro-etale sheaves and hence enough injectives. Functor.rightDerivedFunctorPlusCompIso and rightDerivedFunctorPlusCompIso' applied to finiteClosedUpperShriek, closed direct image and global sections, with supportSectionIso, give e. Their canonical unit factorization equations, functoriality and cancellation of inverse isomorphisms give precisely the required three-unit equality. On I and its injective images, the Mathlib right-derived unit instances supply every IsIso clause. This stays entirely in the stated bounded-below derived categories, so no comparison with unbounded replacements is needed.

For any chain map t, extensionality reduces the final two squares to each degree. Apply naturality of supportModelInclusion to t.f n and naturality of the open adjunction unit to t.f n. The section comparisons are natural isomorphisms by construction, and the derived comparison is assembled from natural isomorphisms with their canonical unit factorizations.
